responsibility: Defines the method-lookup interface and shared method-call data structures, coordinating probing, confirmation, fully qualified call resolution, and method-related diagnostics for expression type checking.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is narrowly scoped to method and associated-function lookup during expression checking: it provides probing/query hookup plus `FnCtxt` helpers for selecting callees, resolving UFCS calls, and producing method-call diagnostics, rather than managing the whole check phase or a crate-wide analysis like coherence/outlives/variance.
